name: Thorn Creek Audubon Environmental Grants
summary: Small grants of up to $500 from an Audubon chapter in Illinois to local organisations for habitat restoration, wildlife protection and environmental education projects.

status.quote: Grant applications are considered as they are received.

access.quote: CLICK HERE to download the submission requirements and application

window.quote: Grant applications are considered as they are received.

amount.quote: Thorn Creek Audubon offers financial assistance, up to $500 per grant, to local organization projects focused on environmental education, habitat restoration, or wildlife protection and management.
